formulas.formula: For servers and bartenders: track every shift, know your real hourly rate, and budget with confidence.
1. Setup: the year, how much of your income to set aside for taxes, your jobs with their hourly wage, and your shift types.
2. Budget: your monthly bills and spending. Their total becomes your monthly income goal (or type your own goal on Setup).
3. Shifts: after every shift, log the hours, sales, cash tips, card tips and what you tipped out.
4. Monthly: income, hours and dollars per hour for every month, with taxes set aside and how you did against your goal.
5. Best Shifts: which days, shifts and jobs pay the most per hour. Use it to pick up the right shifts.
6. Dashboard: this month at a glance, including how many more shifts you need to hit your goal.
Leave it blank on a shift to use the job's wage from Setup. Type it to override (like a training shift).
Cash tips + card tips - tip-out. Tip-out is what you share with bussers, bartenders or hosts.
Your tips (before tip-out) divided by your sales. Leave Sales blank if you don't track it.
Tips are taxable income. Setting aside a % of every shift keeps tax time stress-free.
What's left of your goal this month, divided by your average take-home per shift this year.
Clear the white cells on Shifts and Budget, then update Setup.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you.
Green: goal reached, or your best-paying option.
Red: below goal, or something to check.
Thank you for your purchase! Here's to big tip nights.
The basics. Everything else uses these.
Optional: pick a date to preview that month. Blank = today.
